_comment: nr2grafana mapping config. Copy this file, adjust to your LGTM stack, and pass it with: nr2grafana convert --config my-mappings.json. Every key is optional; anything omitted falls back to built-in defaults (see: python3 -m nr2grafana example-config).
_comment_datasources: Default '${...}' uids become `type: datasource` template variables that bind to your default Mimir/Loki/Tempo datasources on import. To pin panels to specific datasources instead, replace with concrete uids, e.g. "uid": "mimir".
_comment_label_map: New Relic attribute -> Prometheus/Loki label, applied in WHERE, FACET, and variable queries. Merged over a large built-in default map (appName->service_name, k8s.pod.name->pod, httpResponseCode->http_response_status_code, ...).
_comment_metric_map: NR metric name -> Prometheus metric. 'type' (gauge|counter|histogram) controls how aggregations translate (rate/increase vs avg_over_time vs histogram_quantile). Anything not listed is name-normalized (dots->underscores) and type-guessed, flagged needs-review.
_comment_spanmetrics: otel = traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds/_calls_total (OTel collector spanmetrics connector default); otel-seconds = ..._duration_seconds; tempo = traces_spanmetrics_latency/_calls_total (Tempo metrics-generator); or set span_metrics overrides explicitly.
_comment_http: semconv = http_server_request_duration_seconds (current OTel semconv); legacy = http_server_duration_milliseconds (older agents).
